title: Personal cabinet
intro: Optional section: favorites, personal selections, search history and subscriptions. The whole site works without registration.
noRequests: The cabinet has no applications, orders, payments or request statuses. Requests to the archive are filed only through eGov.kz and e-Otinish.
unavailable: The cabinet is temporarily unavailable. The rest of the site works without it.

auth.deleteConfirm: Delete the cabinet with favorites, selections, history and subscriptions? This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid_credentials: Wrong e-mail or password. After 5 failed attempts sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes.
errors.password_length: The password must be 10 to 256 characters.
errors.password_too_weak: The password is too simple or starts/ends with a space.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.limit_reached: The limit of entries has been reached.
errors.not_found: The item was not found or is no longer published.
errors.generic: The action failed. Please try again.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.empty: Nothing yet. Use “Add to favorites” on document, exhibition and news pages.

searches.title: Search history
searches.hint: Queries made through this form are saved here.

password.title: Change password
password.note: Other devices will have to sign in again. Reset by e-mail is unavailable: mail delivery is not connected.
password.done: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is wrong. After 5 failed attempts sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes.
password.unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.

reset.requestHint: Enter the e-mail your account is registered with. We will send a link to set a new password.
reset.requestSent: If this address is registered, an e-mail with a link has been sent. Check your inbox, including the spam folder.
reset.done: Password changed. You can now sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidLink: The link is invalid or has expired.

emailConfirm.title: E-mail confirmation
emailConfirm.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to your account and resend the confirmation e-mail.

emailBanner.text: Confirm your e-mail address using the link in the message.
emailBanner.sent: The e-mail has been sent. Open the link in it.
emailBanner.tooOften: E-mails are being sent too often. Wait a little and try again.
